title: State Machines
description: JSON Schema for the AST output generated by the state machine parser.

StateMachine.description: The full representation of a parsed *.state-machine.md file.

name.description: The title of the state machine (from the H1 heading).

overview.description: A brief description of the state machine's purpose.

source.description: The path to the source markdown file, relative to the project root's parent directory.

states.description: A list of all valid states for this machine.

initialState.description: The state in which the machine starts.

data.description: Data attributes associated with the state machine. Keyed by attribute name, mapping to the attribute description.

dataExampleValues.description: Examples of data combinations, either synthesized from inline examples or explicitly defined in a combination table. By schema convention, an empty string value encodes an undefined/absent value for that attribute.

defaultPreconditions.description: Default precondition states declared in the Transitions section under 'Default preconditions:'. Each entry is a state name whose owning machine is resolved at generation time. The state is prepended as a Given precondition step for every transition that does not already mention a state from the same machine.

transitions.description: Optional transition table defining how the machine moves between states based on triggers. When omitted, this is equivalent to an empty array.

impossible.description: Impossible trigger and state combinations, grouped by origin.

irrelevant.description: Explicitly declared combinations where triggers produce the same outcome regardless of the listed state.

DefaultPrecondition.description: A single default precondition state entry, used in the 'Default preconditions:' block of a Transitions section.

state.description: The plain text name of the default precondition state.

arguments.description: Optional data attributes associated with this default precondition state. Inherited from the markdown `Default preconditions:` block when the entry carries inline backtick arguments.

description.description: Optional description providing additional info about the default precondition.

StateDefinition.description: A state belonging to this state machine.

name.description: The plain text name of the state, with emphasis markup removed.

description.description: Optional description providing additional info about the state.

impliedConditions.description: Data value conditions implied by this state, declared as indented sub-bullets in the state definition.

sourceLine.description: The 1-based line number within the source file defining this state.

ImpliedCondition.description: A data value condition implied by being in a particular state (from an implied-condition sub-bullet).

condition.description: The value condition that holds when the state is active.

Transition.description: A single transition definition describing how the machine moves between states.

id.description: Unique string identifier for this transition (e.g. '001', 'T01a'). Optional in test fixtures; assigned by the parser or renumber command when missing.

states.description: Optional combined precondition states: external preconditions plus the machine's own precondition state. When omitted, this is equivalent to an empty array.

trigger.description: The event or state-change that initiates the transition.

result.description: The resulting state after the transition.

notes.description: Additional context or side effects for the transition. Optional.

sourceLine.description: The 1-based line number within the source file defining this transition.

StateRef.description: A reference to a state (either internal or external), potentially with data arguments.

name.description: The plain text name of the state.

arguments.description: Optional data attributes associated with this state reference.

Trigger.description: The event or state-change that initiates a transition.

StateTrigger.description: A trigger that fires when another machine enters a specific state.

type.description: Discriminator value identifying this as a state trigger.

arguments.description: Optional data attributes associated with this trigger.

EventTrigger.description: A trigger representing an external event driven by an action.

type.description: Discriminator value identifying this as an event trigger.

name.description: The plain text name of the event.

arguments.description: Optional data attributes associated with this trigger.

Argument.description: A data attribute reference, mapped from backticks in the text, with optional qualifiers, modifiers, a condition, or a result. The `qualifier` property and the `modifier` property are mutually exclusive: an argument uses either `qualifier` alone (simple form) or `modifier` with optional `preQualifier`/`postQualifier` (modified form), never both. The `condition` property and the `result` property are likewise mutually exclusive: a state or trigger argument uses `condition` (a precondition or trigger-constraint filter); a transition result argument uses `result` (the postcondition value or reference it sets) instead.

qualifier.description: A qualifying preposition (e.g. 'for', 'as') placed before the backtick reference when no modifier is present. Mutually exclusive with `modifier`.

preQualifier.description: A preposition (e.g. 'for', 'as') preceding the modifier. Only used with `modifier`, not with `qualifier`.

modifier.description: A keyword describing the relationship between this value and the value elsewhere (e.g. 'not', 'different', 'next', 'incremented'). Mutually exclusive with `qualifier`.

postQualifier.description: Text following the modifier, used for sentence structuring. Only used with `modifier`, not with `qualifier`.

name.description: The name of the data attribute being referenced.

condition.description: A precondition or trigger-constraint value condition constraining the attribute to a specific subset of its possible values. Used on state and trigger arguments; a transition result argument uses `result` instead.

result.description: The postcondition value or attribute reference a transition result argument sets on the resulting state's attribute, written `attribute set to value` (or `set to undefined`) in the Result column. Used only on a transition's `result` arguments; a state or trigger argument uses `condition` instead.

suffix.description: Plain words following the backtick argument span (after any post-qualifier), used for human-readable sentence continuations such as 'prefilled' or 'only'.

Condition.description: A constraint on the data attribute's value (e.g., '=', '>', 'in range', 'as', 'not as', 'undefined').

operator.description: The condition operator. The 'undefined' operator is unary and carries no value. The 'defined' operator is its unary opposite: it requires a value to be present, without specifying which.

value.description: The literal value or array of values for the condition. Absent when operator is 'undefined'.

valueIsReference.description: When true, `value` names another data attribute (declared in any state machine in the AST) whose row value is substituted dynamically at generation time, instead of being a literal. Set directly by the grammar: a backticked condition value is a reference, a quoted or numeric one is a literal. Only permitted on a transition result argument's `result` (see the `Result` definition); a state or trigger argument's `condition` rejects it (validation) since only a result can resolve dynamically.

Result.description: The postcondition value or attribute reference a transition result argument sets on an attribute, written `attribute set to value` (or `set to undefined`) in the Result column (REQ-089). Always an equality assignment — the `set to` phrasing has no other operator, so unlike `Condition`, `Result` carries no `operator` field. An empty object (no `value`) means the attribute is set to undefined.

value.description: The literal value, or the name of the referenced attribute (when `valueIsReference` is true), the result sets the attribute to. Absent when the result sets the attribute to undefined.

valueIsReference.description: When true, `value` names another data attribute (declared in any state machine in the AST) whose row value is substituted dynamically at generation time, instead of being a literal. Set directly by the grammar: a backticked result value is a reference, a quoted or numeric one is a literal. A result is the only condition/result site allowed to carry a reference (REQ-424).

ImpossibleSection.description: Impossible trigger and state combinations, grouped by origin. The `defined` array holds explicitly declared entries. The optional `inferred` array is populated by the infer step.

defined.description: Explicitly declared impossible trigger and state combinations.

inferred.description: Impossible trigger and state combinations derived by the infer step, absent when only the parser output is present.

ImpossibleTrigger.description: A row declaring an impossible state-trigger combination.

states.description: The preconditions/states that make this combination impossible.

IrrelevantTrigger.description: A row declaring an irrelevant state-trigger combination.

states.description: The preconditions/states that make this combination irrelevant.
